title: The modal module's doc claims more than modal() decides, and no test showed the wheel is held under the prompt
why: The doc says the prompt 'draws over everything' while close_prompt's ask says 'the lightbox draws over it' and closes it; and modal() is asked by the keyboard, the wheel zoom and drops only, while clicks and typing are egui::Modal's and the wheel scroll is Lightbox::capture_wheel's own check (lightbox/mod.rs:96). The unverified gap is not a bug: a wheel turn does not scroll the page under the prompt. The remedy is the doc fix plus the missing reader test.

title: The type name Modal collides with egui::Modal, and tests build LightboxState by hand in six places
why: close_prompt/mod.rs uses egui::Modal::new in the same crate as crate::app::modal::Modal. The literal count is six, not five: app/tests.rs:295, shortcuts/tests.rs:258, frame/tests.rs:68, lightbox/tests.rs:17, close_prompt/tests.rs:273 and the new modal/tests.rs:10.
size: rename: 4 files, about 12 mentions. Helper: 6 test files, about 40 lines removed
guards: Unit tests only. Pick the name together with 21-F3 so that Prompt, Overlay and the prompt's state type do not collide again.

title: A modal unit test pins a state the app cannot reach
why: the_prompt_comes_before_a_picture_enlarged_under_it opens the lightbox after the prompt asks. Every path to the prompt goes through ask, which sets lightbox.open = None (close_prompt/mod.rs, 'The prompt has to be seen'), and while it asks egui's modal layer takes the click that would enlarge a picture. The branch order it pins is still covered by the other three tests.
guards: Coverage of modal() is unchanged (both branches are hit by the two tests kept). The other two unit tests restate the function but are the only unit-level cover and stay.
